title: Insanely satisfying game, and I can't believe how Claude is great with videos
author: One_Low8664
selftext:
Create BLOOM EATER: a tiny living seed fighting through a vast, predatory orbital greenhouse.  
Loop: dodge, auto-fire, collect nutrients and choose mutations that visibly transform your body and combine into surprising attacks.  
Art: scientific botanical engraving meets psychedelic album covers—ink-black space, ivory stems, coral pollen and acid-green sap, with tactile sound and magnificent flowering bosses.  
Ship a complete browser game; take creative risks, keep combat readable, and make every run ask: “What could I become next?”

Play it here: [https://bug.games/games/bloom-eater](https://bug.games/games/bloom-eater)
